label: User Task
description: Work that a person must carry out. The workflow waits until the task is completed.

performers.label: Performers
performers.description: The principals - users or groups - allowed to complete this task. Absent or empty means nobody; the built-in "everyone" group means any authenticated user.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.description: The outcomes a person may record when completing this task, e.g. "approved", "rejected". A routing gateway decides on whichever one they choose.
